releases.summary:
First public release. archon started as an Arch-only, security-monitored
AUR package manager and grew into a cross-distro CLI while keeping that
core intact.

## Highlights

- **Cross-distro support** — `archon install/remove/search` now works on
  Arch, Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora/RHEL, openSUSE, Alpine, NixOS, Void, and
  Gentoo. Off Arch, archon detects the host via `/etc/os-release` and
  delegates to the native package manager (`apt`, `dnf`, `zypper`, `apk`,
  `nix-env`, `xbps`, `emerge`) — same commands everywhere, no need to
  remember which flags belong to which tool. NixOS installs correctly run
  **without** sudo, since `nix-env` installs into the user's own profile.
- **Ranked search** — `archon search <term>` is ordered by AUR popularity
  (a proxy for what people actually install) instead of alphabetically, so
  `archon search chrome` surfaces `google-chrome` first instead of burying
  it under 70 zero-vote packages. Exact matches always pin to the top.
- **Published on crates.io** — `cargo install archon-cli` gets you a
  binary named `archon`, eBPF monitor included (no separate nightly build
  step required).

## Core (Arch)

- Dependency resolution across official repos *and* the AUR in a single
  graph — `provides=()` virtual packages, version constraints, conflict
  detection, correct AUR build ordering.
- AUR packages build inside a bubblewrap sandbox: two-stage `makepkg`,
  network allowed only while fetching sources, fully unshared during the
  actual build.
- `--report` monitors the build with eBPF — every exec, file write, and
  network connection is checked against a policy, and archon only offers
  to install if the report is clean.
- "Did you mean" suggestions when an exact package name isn't found.

## Quality

- 171 unit/integration tests, zero clippy warnings.
- Every non-obvious design decision — three real concurrency/mount-order
  bugs found only through live testing — is written up in
  [docs/DESIGN.md](https://github.com/ravindran-dev/archon/blob/main/docs/DESIGN.md).

## Known limitations

- The sandbox and eBPF monitor are Arch-only — other distros get
  resolution + install via their native tool, not sandboxed/monitored
  builds. `--report` says so explicitly rather than silently no-op'ing.
- Cross-distro backends are argv-construction only; off Arch, the native
  tool owns dependency resolution and its own confirmation prompt.

## Install

```zsh
cargo install archon-cli
```

See the [README](https://github.com/ravindran-dev/archon#readme) for full
usage, supported distros, and prerequisites.

Hertix 1.0.23

- Search exact-video, regional catalog and transliterated title sources together, keeping responsive results and prioritizing synchronized lyrics.
- Add additional regional timed lyric catalogs and timed video-caption fallback when a catalog has no match.
- Refresh the music client version from its service page so exact-video lyric requests remain compatible as that service changes.
- Cancel an old track’s lyric lookup cleanly when playback changes, so results cannot overwrite the current lyric state.
- Keep each playlist track linked to its exact video so source-based lyrics lookup works for individual songs.
- Search lyrics catalogs with native-script and Latin transliterations for Tamil and other Indian languages.
- Prefer time-synchronized lyrics when available and avoid false line highlighting for plain lyrics.
- Replace saved plain lyrics with synchronized lyrics when a better match is found.
- Prevent a crash when older saved tracks are opened or rescanned after adding optional lyric source metadata.
- Keep older library records and backups compatible with the new lyric source field.

Hertix 1.0.22

- Regional lyrics search now tries original-script and Tanglish queries and checks several closely matched YouTube Music sources.
- Download playlists directly from YouTube search results.
- Playlist retries skip completed tracks and retry failed tracks only. Older jobs recover completed tracks from saved files.
- Show the Hertix symbol when song artwork is unavailable.
- Make contextual popups and update notices more translucent so the page behind them remains visible.

Hertix 1.0.21

- Route app updates through the stable release asset endpoint.
- Retry temporary download errors and resume an interrupted APK transfer.

Hertix 1.0.20

- Confirmation dialogs and cloud file selection now share the translucent glass popup styling used by contextual menus.
- Popup surfaces remain translucent on older Android releases, and the update prompt shows more of the blurred screen behind it.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ravindran-dev/Hertix/compare/v1.0.18...v1.0.19

### Hertix 1.0.18

- Tamil YouTube Music lyrics now detect localized lyrics tabs and show Tanglish by default, with a Tamil-script toggle.
- YouTube audio downloads use concurrent fragments, HTTP chunking, resume support, and stronger transient-failure retries.
- The update dialog uses a compact frosted layout with scrollable notes and stacked actions.
- Player options share the home menu's frosted backdrop. The home logo is larger and the account/menu spacing is balanced.

Install from the in-app update prompt. Account and cloud-sync data remain intact.

### Hertix 1.0.17

- Lyrics now check the playing video's YouTube Music lyrics tab, including Tamil and other regional-language results.
- Exact-video YouTube captions are used as a last-resort lyrics source after lyrics catalogs.
- Updated the Hertix launcher and home-page branding with the newly supplied purple H play symbol and wordmark.

Install from the in-app update prompt. Account and cloud-sync data remain intact.

### Hertix 1.0.16

- YouTube Music search now uses the WEB_REMIX/Innertube path, avoiding the YouTube Data API daily search quota.
- Search is tuned to the device locale for regional results.
- Lyrics lookup accepts rich synchronized responses and adds KuGou's timestamped LRC catalog as a regional-language fallback.
- The update popup is a compact frosted dialog with readable release notes and stacked actions.

Install from the in-app update prompt. Existing account and cloud-sync data are preserved.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ravindran-dev/Hertix/compare/v1.0.14...v1.0.15

Lyrics lookup now tries the source YouTube video ID, supporting regional-language matches even when file metadata lists a publisher instead of the artist. Exact-title matching is more tolerant of missing or different video durations while still rejecting ambiguous matches. The updater popup now uses a tighter frosted-glass layout with a stronger blurred backdrop. Download tabs show only their names; totals remain in the summary.

Downloads now show live Active, Completed, and Failed counts and switch to the outcome tab when a job finishes. Song and playlist download details have clearer progress, error, playlist contents, and local file actions. Lyrics matching handles YouTube lyric-video titles and publisher channels more reliably. The player track actions popup has a refreshed translucent layout with grouped controls.

Downloads: Active, Completed, and Failed tabs now show live counts and move to the completed or failed state when a download finishes. Download detail pages distinguish songs from playlists and show progress, playlist contents, errors, and local-file actions. Deleting a local download keeps its history entry. Lyrics lookup now ignores publisher names and YouTube lyric-video labels when matching tracks. The update popup has a shorter layout when release notes are unavailable.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ravindran-dev/Hertix/compare/v1.0.10...v1.0.11
